control_failures.control_label: controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of pressure energy at V-4110

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels on V-4110 and PSV-4110 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically monitoring seal-face condition and temperature. V-4110 (hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel) is in service for diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels had been bypassed. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 31 January 2010 a hazard report was recorded on V-4110 and PSV-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during start-up after maintenance; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
